item.title: Building a semantic search engine in ±250 lines of Python
item.description: Our keyword search engine can't find 'alcoholic beverage disaster in England' even though the London Beer Flood is right there. In this post, we add semantic search using sentence-transformers embeddings and cosine similarity to find documents by meaning, not just matching words.

item.title: Migrating my hopelessly outdated Hugo blog with Claude Code
item.description: I haven't really touched my blog since 2019. The theme was ancient, jQuery was everywhere, and I kept putting off the inevitable migration. Then I decided to let an LLM do it. Here's what happened when Claude Code spent an evening trying to modernize my setup.
